subject.title: feat(codex): configure native app tool policy

question: Should OpenClaw accept `codexPlugins.plugins.<plugin>.tools.<exact-tool-key>.enabled` as a durable supported operator policy for native Codex apps?
rationale: This PR creates a new security-sensitive config contract and upgrade behavior, so correctness alone cannot decide whether this is the intended product boundary.

options.title: Accept after proof and security review
options.body: Land this shape if live app-server proof and maintainer security review confirm exact-key projection and fail-closed guards.

options.title: Narrow the contract
options.body: Keep the PR open but ask for a smaller or less durable config surface if maintainers want less policy in `openclaw.json`.

options.title: Decline per-tool policy
options.body: Close this PR and the linked issue if app-level admission plus Codex defaults are the intended boundary.

recommendation.title: Accept after proof and security review
recommendation.body: Land this shape if live app-server proof and maintainer security review confirm exact-key projection and fail-closed guards.

likelyOwner.reason: He introduced native Codex plugin app support and owns the closest merged policy decisions on this surface.
